auth_signin_description: Sign in to your Mochifile account. Accounts are not available yet.
auth_signup_description: Create a free Mochifile account. Accounts are not available yet.
auth_signin_sub: Sign in to your Mochifile account
auth_signup_sub: Accounts are not available yet. The free browser tools need no account.
auth_email_error: Enter an email address like you@example.com.
auth_passwordless_note: When accounts open, sign-in is planned to use a one-time code sent by email, with no password.
auth_use_label: What will you mainly use Mochifile for?
auth_news_text: Optional. Account and security emails are sent either way, and you can change this any time.
auth_terms: By creating an account you agree to the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy.
auth_benefit_limits_text: They work without signing up, and their limits do not depend on an account.
auth_benefit_tools_text: Images today. PDF and video tools are planned.
auth_benefit_privacy_text: Hidden details such as location are removed from every result.
auth_benefit_free_text: The free browser tools need no sign-up and no credit card.
auth_preview_note: A screen that does not work yet. No email was sent.
auth_code_text: This is how the next step will look: you would enter the 6-digit code from your email.
auth_code_error: Enter the 6 digits of the code.
auth_wrong_error: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
auth_expired_text: Codes would only work for a short time, and you could ask for a new one.
auth_unavailable_account: Accounts are not available yet, so no email was sent and no code was checked.
auth_unavailable_google: Signing in with Google is not available yet.
auth_unavailable_notice: Accounts and sign-in by email are not available yet. This page shows how they are planned to look: nothing is sent when you press a button.
